summary.root_cause_text: ops changed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable; the worker processed orders without payment.
recommended: Verify payments-v2 endpoint reachability/address before retrying the migration
Add a payment-failure alert and a pre-change validation for provider URL changes

queue_max: 1000

root_causes: ops changed payment_provider_url to internal://payments-v2 (provider migration), which is unreachable; the worker processed orders without payment.
evidence: DEBUG payment: provider call failed: payment provider unreachable at internal://payments-v2 (24 lines)
recent_changes: config payment_provider_url payments-v1 -> payments-v2 by ops at 13:20:06
args.impact: Alert showed 9 of 26 orders without payment (unpaid money_impact total_sar 3984.33). The loss kept growing during the incident. Reprocessing paid 35 orders, money_recovered total_sar 18304.7 (SAR 6240.5, USD 3217.12). No failures.
recommended_actions: Verify payments-v2 endpoint reachability/address before retrying the migration
Add a payment-failure alert and a pre-change validation for provider URL changes
args.summary: An ops config change pointed the payment provider at the unreachable payments-v2, so orders were processed with no payment while /health stayed green. I reverted the URL to payments-v1 and reprocessed all unpaid orders. All invariants are now green.
